body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target also resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
Protect a second willing creature within 1 unit of the first.

rider.title: Aether Thread
rider.html: Gain an Aether Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: increase its Success Die by 1, to a maximum of 10. This does not generate Surges.
